source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.3

data.summary:
This model follows these rules:

- it is placed in Reserves at the start of the battle, and neither it nor any unit embarked in it counts toward any limit on the number of Reserves units your army begins the battle with
- it can arrive during the Reinforcements step of any of [your first 3 Movement phases](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), whatever the mission rules say
- once it arrives, units embarked in it can disembark, and any that do are placed more than 9" from every enemy model
